name: kettlebell bottom up one arm bench press
description: A bench press holding the kettlebell upside down, which forces tight control of the shoulder and wrist.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell upside down above your chest.
Squeeze the handle and keep your wrist stacked.
Lower the bell slowly toward your chest.
Press it back up while keeping it balanced.
Use a light weight and switch arms after your reps.
